pasqueflower.definition: n. any plant of the genus Pulsatilla; sometimes included in genus Anemone
pasqueflower.translation:
n. 欧白头翁花, 野藏红花
[医] 洋白头翁

pasquil.definition:
n. See Pasquin.
v. t. See Pasquin.
pasquil.translation: n. 讽刺诗, 讽刺文

pasquin.definition:
n. A lampooner; also, a lampoon. See Pasquinade.
v. t. To lampoon; to satiraze.

pasquinade.definition: n a composition that imitates or misrepresents somebody's style, usually in a humorous way
pasquinade.translation:
n. 讽刺诗(文), 讽刺写作
vt. 写文章讽刺(或攻击)

pasquinades.translation: 讽刺诗, 讽刺文( pasquinade的名词复数 )
